company.introduction: Pershing Square Holdings is a listed investment company providing exposure to a portfolio managed by Pershing Square Capital Management. Its approach involves a relatively concentrated set of investments, making the performance of individual holdings important to overall results. Shareholders participate through the investment company's shares, whose market price can differ from the net value of the underlying portfolio. Returns reflect investment gains and losses, income, expenses and any hedging or financing arrangements. The structure is therefore different from an operating company selling goods or services. Portfolio decisions, concentration, market conditions and the discount or premium at which its shares trade are central to understanding performance.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
